scenario_description:
Objective: Finish projecting a photo reminiscence slideshow during this afternoon's memory-table tea.
Emerging Need: The rec-room setup attempt begins with the AV cart and laptop connected, then stops when the only USB-C adapter breaks and the projector has no signal.
Decision Context: Pre-event notes identify a private, time-limited spare-adapter hold for this exact after-start hardware failure, while observable records establish the setup window, paid cart access, and that the room's loaner is unavailable.
Consequence: Timely help could restore the same slideshow setup before elder arrivals; after the handoff window passes, the tea proceeds without the intended projected photos.

parameter.title: Memory-table tea with photo slideshow
parameter.description: Rec-room setup begins at 1:45 p.m.; elder arrivals expected from 2:50 p.m.; projected photo welcome planned before tea at 3:05 p.m.

parameter.reference: AV cart key deposit for photo slideshow
parameter.description: Deposit for using the rec-room AV cart during the memory-table tea setup.

parameter.content: I’m in the rec room now with the AV cart unlocked. Laptop is open, slideshow file is loaded, and I’m plugging the USB-C adapter into the projector before people arrive.

Noting this here: the USB-C-to-HDMI adapter split apart in the port. The projector says no signal, I don’t have another connector in my bag, and the slideshow setup is stopped with the laptop still on the cart.

parameter.subject: AV cart loaner status for today
parameter.body: For today's rec-room use, the building's spare USB-C HDMI dongle is already checked out until after 4:00 p.m. Staff cannot make another adapter available during your 1:45-2:45 setup window.

parameter.content: The first elders are seated and the photo welcome is starting with the screen still blank. The slideshow file is ready, but the projector connection has not come back.
